description:
The image depicts a large, white, plastic statue of a cow with a bull's head and a bike seat attached to its back. The cow is positioned facing left, with its front legs raised and its tongue sticking out. The bull's head is yellow with brown hair and has a white horn. The bike seat is black with white lettering that reads "ciao" and has a white handlebar attached to it.

The background of the image appears to be a blue sky with trees visible behind
